issue.title: www.polybuzz.ai
issue.body:
### Issue URL (Ads) [https://www.polybuzz.ai/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.polybuzz.ai%2F) ### Comment > Previously, AdGuard DNS was working perfectly fine on the PolyBuzz app, however as of today it is no longer working. I have a subscription to AdGuard DNS specifically for PolyBuzz so if it no longer works I see no reason to keep it, please fix this. It would not allow me to specify that this is for an app, not a website. ### Screenshots
